note: P4's stage-1 machinery is implemented and its inputs are frozen; no P4 model has been fitted. This file is the interlock. `nn.p4_stage1` refuses to fit anything while `state` is not exactly "authorised", and flipping it is a commit rather than a flag, so beginning a P4 fit is a reviewable diff with a name and a reason attached to it. The runner requires a second, independent confirmation at the command line as well, so a Make target or a script cannot start a fit on its own. `preregistration_hash` must equal `nn.p4_preregistration.preregistration_hash()` at the moment of the run: an authorisation granted under one design does not carry over to an edited one. Authorising stage 1 is not authorising stage 2 — P4-HOLD is a separate one-shot gate in `nn.p4_holdout`, and nothing here opens it. `preregistration_hash` was rebound to the current design when source-protocol amendment A1 (docs/p4_preregistration.md §3.4a) added open_interest_duplicate_policy to the hashed payload. The state was not_authorised before that amendment and is not_authorised after it: rebinding this file to the active design grants nothing, and no P4 fit has been run under this hash or under the one it replaced. Only the active hash is recorded here — the superseded value is historical provenance and lives in docs/p4_preregistration.md, which is where the amendment is explained.
